purpose: Unknown-image generalization with a single neural forward and no external inference optimization

screening.width_initialization: scratch, identical target sequence and optimizer settings
screening.window_ablation: Uniform windows, sample covariance, identical parents/batches/optimizer. Report both sizes; keep size7 in frozen selection score.
screening.search: Sequential one-factor screening; no Cartesian product. Follow-up starts and choices recorded before test evaluation.
screening.continuation: Continue the strongest scratch width and strongest warm candidate if validation justifies it; preserve epoch-zero candidates for warm starts.
screening.loss_calibration: Weights chosen before loss trials from train-only gradient norms; no test metric used.

teacher.labels: Train-only natural image quartets, phase-only optimization performed offline
teacher.quality_gate: Every stored teacher must have canonical exported reconstruction score >= its neural initialization; strictly improved count is reported separately.
teacher.comparison: Same teacher target tensors and replay RNG in supervised/physics stages and matched zero-teacher-weight control

final_test.selection: Freeze at most two validation finalists plus controls before opening held-out quality metrics
final_test.external_quartet: Four predeclared BSDS test images; visualization only, excluded from model selection and promotion score
final_test.promotion: Require held-out weighted score gain >=0.002 over production baseline, positive lower paired-bootstrap bound for the combined new broad/natural cohorts, and no primary-cohort mean PCC/global/windowed SSIM drop >0.003 or mean-worst-PCC/p10 weakest-joint drop >0.005. Otherwise keep production unchanged.

metrics: Canonical uint8 phase PNG and uint8 peak-normalized amplitude reconstructions; global population SSIM and uniform valid 7x7 sample-covariance SSIM reported separately
latency: CPU4threads,10warmup,50seed-interleaved measurements,forward and complete neural synthesis separately
